coordinate_contract.units: world units are pixels in the reference project; cell_size is the only scale that must be preserved when porting

field.cell_size_rule: cell = max(8, floor(min(play_rect_width / cols, play_rect_height / rows)))

neighbors.diagonal_rule: k >= 4 is diagonal; both orthogonal side cells (x+dx, y) and (x, y+dy) must be walkable, otherwise the diagonal is skipped (no corner cutting)

build.algorithm: multi-source breadth-first search from all goals
build.queue: FIFO, goals enqueued in the goals[] order
build.cost_model: uniform step cost 1; replace BFS with Dijkstra (binary heap) to support weighted terrain without changing the flow-field output format
build.flow_rule: for every reachable non-goal cell, choose the walkable neighbor with the strictly smallest integration value; first minimum in neighbor order wins ties

steering.speed_clamp: each agent's own speed = cell_size * 2.9 * speed_scale[i]

separation.pair_rule: 5 offsets (self + right + right-up + right-down + down) so each pair is accumulated once

sampling.method: bilinear interpolation over the four cell centers around the agent, then normalize
sampling.valid_corners: only open and reachable corners participate; weight_sum must exceed 0.0001
sampling.fallback: use the flow vector of the cell containing the agent
sampling.normalization: normalize the mixed vector; zero-length result falls back

relative_gate_example.note: relative gates are for shared/loaded machines; absolute gates require a clean machine

determinism_rules: keep the neighbor order table above unchanged
keep BFS FIFO order and goals[] order
keep the strict '<' tie-break when choosing the flow neighbor
seed every RNG explicitly; never use process time or frame delta in logic
iterate arrays in index order; do not use unordered maps in the hot path
use the same INF sentinel and the same int32 integration field

unit_mapping.unity_2d: 1 unit = 1 m; multiply cell_size by 0.01 for a 24 px cell to become 0.24 m, or keep 1 cell = 1 unit
unit_mapping.unreal: 1 uu = 1 cm; multiply reference px by 2.54 using 96 dpi, or define 1 cell = 100 uu and scale agent radius/speed accordingly
unit_mapping.three_js: 1 unit = 1 m; define cell = 1.0 and scale all lengths by cell size
